exact_result: Draft proofs of sequential weakly smooth classical-psh regularization for arbitrary targets on reduced boundaryless good strict curves over perfect complete nontrivially valued fields with a countable dense subset; regularization of every arbitrary classical psh function on saturated proper connected-fibre domains over those curves with local analytic sections, including singular fibres and bases; and a sharp residue-countability threshold for a closed-disc boundary-spike function, with higher-dimensional counterexamples when the residue field is uncountable. The original higher-dimensional local sheaf characterization remains open.
concrete_gaps: All arbitrary classical psh germs on nonsaturated higher-dimensional affine neighborhoods, including affine charts of the proper-fibre examples.
A sharp necessary-and-sufficient geometric characterization of the original higher-dimensional good strict spaces, including boundaryless spaces.
General singularity, normalization and scalar-descent ranges beyond the proved finite-branch curve construction and saturated proper-fibre sector.
General sequential results over nonperfect fields or fields without a countable dense subset, and all boundary configurations beyond the explicit Gauss-point family.
Independent mathematical verification of the new draft proofs; source hashes and TeX builds are not such verification.
